Live Baccarat

Not a hairless popular than roulette and blackjack, baccarat is a unique card game played between the player and banker (no other players). With a house edge no lower than 1%, the winning odds are in favour of the banco (banker).

The pallet and cards used in the game are completely unique to the game itself. The goal of the game is to beat the dealer’s hand with a higher hand. There are three possible outcomes in the game – player win, Banker win, and a tie. Players can bet on either hand which adds an extra layer of excitement to baccarat.

Live dealer versions of baccarat are made even more exciting thanks to the controlled squeeze streamed in high definition video and crystal clear sound. Evolution Gaming also offers private VIP tables of Live Baccarat as well as No Commission Live Baccarat.

Andar Bahar Online

Andar Bahar is a traditional Indian card game that has captivated players for generations with its simplicity and excitement. Originating in Southern India, this game involves betting on which side, Andar (inside) or Bahar (outside), a card matching the initial card dealt will appear. Its rich history reflects the cultural love for quick-paced and engaging card games. Now, you can experience the thrill of Andar Bahar live on 10CRIC, where you can enjoy the game with a Hindi-speaking live dealer, bringing the authentic casino experience right to your screen.
